sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Stickman vs Noob Hammer are deceptively simple, yet incredibly addictive. Your goal is to move a stickman around using a hammer, either with a friend or on your own. The twist is that you can't simply tap the hammer to move the stickman - you have to use it to bounce the stickman around the level. This adds a fun and challenging layer of complexity to the game, requiring you to carefully plan your movements and use the hammer strategically to overcome obstacles.
The game features a variety of levels, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles. Some levels may have spikes or pitfalls, while others may require you to use the hammer to bounce the stickman up to higher platforms. The game also features a day-night cycle, with different levels available during the day and night.
